FN-BYEPPJJ-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 378
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Terri Collins
Analyst: Michael Russo Date: 02/17/2026
House Bill 378 as introduced would increase the obligations of the Department of Revenue,
paid from the State General Fund, by up to $1,200 annually for each county-employed licensing
administrator that receives additional compensation for being awarded the designation of
"Alabama Certified Licensing Administrator".
However, current law caps the total amount of funding available for such compensation at
$250,000 annually. According to the department, the actual annual compensation that would be
paid under this program, inclusive of this bill, due to this cap, would be an estimated $801.
